params.name: limit
params.description: Max number of results that should be returned

params.name: next_page
params.description: Cursor that indicates where the next page of results should start.

params.name: starting_on
params.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the earliest audit log to return. Cannot be used with 'next_page'.

params.name: ending_before
params.description: RFC 3339 timestamp (exclusive). Cannot be used with 'next_page'.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order by timestamp, e.g. date_asc or date_desc. Defaults to date_asc.

params.name: resource_id
params.description: Optional parameter that can be used to filter which audit logs are returned. If you specify resource_id, you must also specify resource_type.

params.name: resource_type
params.description: Optional parameter that can be used to filter which audit logs are returned. If you specify resource_type, you must also specify resource_id.
